method:
The class was introduced to Boyd's Crit process this morning which has 4 stages.
1: Statements of meaning, what was meaningful, evocative, interesting, exciting and/or striking. 2: Artist as Questioner, asking questions about the work, from the artist. 3: Neutral Questions, responses as neutral opinions, 4: Permissioned Opinions, responders state opinions about the work, but the artist can say no if they don't want to hear it.
related_work: Following this, we were introduced to the crit process that Boyd wanted us to use for the projects. I was given feedback on my project 0 website, and most of it had to do with the object.
results_discussion: I got some interesting feedback from this Crit session, mostly aimed at the device itself, responders found that the device was difficult to understand, and that they didn't know how many components it had. Boyd's feedback specifically was to merge the art concept with the 3d model to produce something that looked like it was drawn in. I also felt at this stage that it would be a good idea to add a Chinese translation of the AI responses, to make it easier to understand for most of the class.
